# GSAP Skills
Canonical source: `greensock/gsap-skills` → `skills/` on `main`.

This is a skill pack. Prefer synchronized `upstream/`; choose the smallest official GSAP `SKILL.md` matching the task (for React work prefer the React-specific skill). If absent, inspect the upstream `skills/` directory with authorized GitHub/network access and follow the chosen skill plus references. Verify animation behavior in a real runtime when possible.

State while `upstream/` is absent: `REMOTE_CANONICAL`.
